title: Local terrain encoding comparison on synthetic visible surfaces
description: A deterministic representation-only benchmark using synthetic Minecraft-like voxel patterns. It does not launch Minecraft, train a model, or measure agent capability.
construct: Storage and query tradeoffs for encoding the same bounded, player-visible surface samples.
research_question: Which local geometry representation offers a useful bandwidth, encode/decode latency, reconstruction, and simple spatial-query tradeoff while preserving the observation-v0 information boundary?

criteria: Any representation claims absent blocks from partial or unavailable visible-surface data.
Any lossless representation fails exact reconstruction of visible sample records.
A representation uses evaluator-only world truth or unobserved block properties.
The benchmark reports latency or bandwidth without preserving per-terrain, per-seed raw measurements.
stop_conditions: Stop the run if a policy input contains fields outside the declared observation-v0 visible-surface subset.
Stop the run if any encoder fails hidden-state conformance or its declared reconstruction contract.

world.source: synthetic generated voxel patterns with a separate evaluator-only hidden block map
world.reset_details: Regenerate six bounded terrain patterns and two observation windows from each declared seed. Only visible v0-style samples enter the encoder.

agents.initialization: stateless encoder invoked with one synthetic policy observation; change-events additionally receives a prior policy observation

permitted_inputs: current collection coverage and declared local sensor scope
prior policy-visible observation for the change-events comparison only
permitted_outputs: encoded visible-surface records or explicitly lossy summaries

privileged_inputs.name: hidden_evaluator_voxel_map
privileged_inputs.reason: Count unseen synthetic blocks and verify that the encoder boundary does not depend on them.

scaffolding.influence: Creates six fixed-shape terrain families and samples visible positions from declared seeds.
scaffolding.accounting: Synthetic fixture setup only; it is not a Minecraft world or agent policy.

scaffolding.influence: Transforms only supplied visible samples into the selected representation.
scaffolding.accounting: Deterministic hand-written representation prototypes; no learned component.

scaffolding.influence: Calculates material counts, nearest visible target distance, adjacency, and lookup reference answers from visible samples; it selects the lookup coordinate after encoding and never supplies evaluator answers to an encoder.
scaffolding.accounting: Evaluator references are never passed to encoders.

trial_plan.warmup: One unrecorded encoder invocation per terrain before timing.
trial_plan.intervention_policy: No intervention after a trial starts; preserve any failure.
trial_plan.order_policy: Execute variants and seeds in manifest order; terrain patterns use a fixed declared order.

metrics.definition: UTF-8 byte length of the deterministic compact JSON representation, excluding runner metadata.
metrics.aggregation: Median across terrain and seed cases; retain raw per-case values.
metrics.failure_treatment: A failed encoder trial is preserved and is not assigned a size.

metrics.definition: Median wall-clock duration of seven encode-plus-compact-JSON-serialization calls for one case.
metrics.aggregation: Report median and interquartile range over raw case medians.
metrics.failure_treatment: A failed trial has no latency value; no retry is allowed.

metrics.definition: Median wall-clock duration of seven compact-JSON-parsing-plus-decode calls for one case.
metrics.aggregation: Report median and interquartile range over raw case medians.
metrics.failure_treatment: A failed trial has no latency value; no retry is allowed.

metrics.definition: Fraction of visible sample records reconstructed with all declared fields exactly; chunk summaries are intentionally lossy.
metrics.aggregation: Mean across terrain and seed cases; report lossless and lossy variants separately.
metrics.failure_treatment: A failed or malformed decode scores zero and remains failed in the trial record.

metrics.definition: Jaccard overlap between positions in the current and prior visible sample collections; diagnostic context for change-event size.
metrics.aggregation: Mean across terrain and seed cases; preserve per-case values.
metrics.failure_treatment: A failed trial has no overlap value.

metrics.definition: Whether counts of each block ID in the visible sample collection are preserved.
metrics.aggregation: Mean of boolean encoded as 0/1 across terrain and seed cases.

metrics.definition: Absolute error in nearest visible gold-block distance from local origin; cases with no visible gold are reported as not applicable.
metrics.aggregation: Mean over applicable terrain and seed cases; preserve null cases.
metrics.failure_treatment: A failed trial is preserved and excluded only from this not-applicable metric's denominator.

metrics.definition: Whether the representation returns the exact observed block ID at an evaluator-selected coordinate known to contain a visible sample.
metrics.aggregation: Mean of boolean encoded as 0/1 across terrain and seed cases.

metrics.definition: Whether the encoding preserves geometric adjacency relationships among currently observed samples without adding unseen neighbors.
metrics.aggregation: Mean of boolean encoded as 0/1 across terrain and seed cases; chunk summaries are intentionally not adjacency-preserving.

metrics.definition: Whether encoder inputs are restricted to declared visible samples, required unknown/coverage semantics are preserved, and outputs are derived solely from those inputs.
metrics.aggregation: All cases must pass; report any failure as a gate failure.
metrics.failure_treatment: Any violation invalidates the representation result.

metrics.definition: Whether changing evaluator-only block identities outside both current and prior visible observations leaves the encoding unchanged.
metrics.aggregation: All cases must pass; any output difference is a hidden-state violation.
metrics.failure_treatment: Any violation invalidates the representation result.

baselines.notes: Canonical lossless reference representation; not a learned policy.
Intentionally lossy coarse summary used to quantify query/reconstruction tradeoffs.

artifacts.description: Raw metrics for each encoder and synthetic terrain case.
Resolved scenario, experiment, source revision, and artifact hashes.

notes: Synthetic representation evidence only. It does not certify an encoding for real Minecraft visibility, model use, or agent behavior.
